title: Forget-Me-Lots
description: A paid message from Forget-Me-Lots. The tea that erases the bad parts.

lines.speaker: ad-ann-deep
lines.text: Haunted by a memory? <p:0.2> One cup of Forget-Me-Lots tea wipes it clean! <p:0.2> That argument, that debt, that name. <p:0.2> Gone. <p:0.2> Forget-Me-Lots, what were we talking about?

lines.text: Forget-Me-Lots may erase more than intended. <p:0> Results are permanent and cannot be reviewed. <p:0> Not responsible for forgotten debts or relatives. <p:0> Terms and conditions apply.
